title: Quality of service
subtitle: OpenBSD 8.0 queues: hfsc classes attached to the interface

cmds:
cat > /tmp/q.conf <<'EOF'
queue rootq on eth2 bandwidth 10Mbit
queue leafq on eth2 bandwidth 2Mbit parent rootq default
pass in quick proto tcp from 10.0.1.10 to 10.0.2.20 port 9095 queue leafq keep state
pass out quick keep state
EOF
ssh srv 'pkill nc 2>/dev/null; (setsid nc -l -p 9095 < /tmp/data.bin >/dev/null 2>&1 &); sleep 1; echo listening'
